name: Gather Event Planner
description: Offline-first celebration and event planning assistant for cross-cultural weddings, milestone birthdays, and community gatherings.

skills.name: Integer Budget Allocation
skills.description: Computes exact integer category budgets using largest-remainder rounding with contingency reserves.
examples: Allocate a 500000 INR budget for an Indian wedding
Split a 5000 USD budget for a 40th birthday

skills.name: Milestone Timeline Scheduling
skills.description: Backward-schedules planning milestones from event date with compression warnings for short horizons.
examples: Generate a timeline for a wedding in 6 months
Create milestone schedule for a community block party

skills.name: Vendor Comparison and Scoring
skills.description: Structured vendor interview guides and all-in quote calculators with tax and deposit breakdown.
examples: Compare catering quotes with service tax and deposits
Vendor interview checklist for wedding venue

skills.name: Deterministic Celebration Ideation
skills.description: Offline-first personalized themes, decor concepts, and run-of-show schedules tailored to event scale.
examples: Generate theme ideas for a golden anniversary
Create day-of run-of-show for a multi-day wedding
